Parts

Ensure peak performance with genuine OEM Morbark parts. Explore top-quality wear parts, genuine replacements, options for competitive equipment, and more.

Service

We understand how necessary your machines are to your day-to-day operations and take pride in being able to offer you unparalleled service. From routine upkeep to complete overhauls, our technicians know these machines inside and out; able to recognize minor issues before they become larger ones and make quick, long-lasting repairs.

Service support

Find A Dealer

We understand that when your equipment goes down, it doesn’t just cost you time; it costs you money. That’s why, when you choose Morbark, you get more than great equipment; you get unmatched service and support. With regular factory trainings for our dealers’ service professionals, you can be sure that our global network of dealers will give you first-class support wherever you are.

data.name: B14.html
data.contents:
Our history

1940's - After World War II

After being stationed in Italy during World War II, our founder, Norval K. "Nub" Morey, returned to Winn, MI to work with his brothers at the family sawmill.

Read our history

1957 - The Beginning

The Log Debarking Apparatus invented and patented by Nub and Robert Baker, results in the founding of the Morbark Portable Debarker Company, the predecessor of Morbark, LLC. The debarkers sold for $3,3450!

Read our history

1960s - Rapid Expansion

Morbark starts to manufacture log debarkers for sawmills. In 1961, orders for nearly 300 machines produce $2 million in gross sales. In 1969 the Morbark Chip-Pac comes to market and is named a Michigan Product of the Year.

Read our history
